senses.gloss: (b. h.) to fall, lie down; to be dropped; to occur.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:2">Sabb. XVI, 2</cite> <he>נָפְלָה דליקה</he> if a conflagration takes place.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:4:8">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="J00572"><he>יקים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 27:26">Deut. XXVII, 26</cite>) <he>וכי יש תורה נוֹפֶלֶת</he> is there a falling law (to need erection)? <cite ref="Nedarim 65b:3">Ned. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>כל הנוֹפֵל אינו נופל לידי וכ׳</he> he who falls (becomes poor) does not immediately fall into the hands of (become dependent on) the charities (but his friends support him for a time).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:11">B. Kam. IX, 11</cite>, a. fr. <he>יִפְּלוּ דמיו לנדבה</he> its equivalent must be surrendered as a donation to the Temple.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:4">B. Bath. IX, 4</cite> <he>האחין … שנ׳ אחד מהן לאומנות נ׳ לאמצע</he> if one of two partner brothers (heirs) has been summoned to public service, his salary goes into the common fund.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4:4">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵇ</cite> top <he>בשביל ששמעתי שנפלה לך ירושה וכ׳</he> since I heard that an inheritance has fallen to thy share at a distant place, take (this as a loan) &c.; a. v. fr.—Imperat. <cite ref="Q00205"><he>פּוֹל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:4">Tosef. Dem. VI, 4</cite> <he>ופול תחתיי וכ׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="I00162"><he>טול</he></cite>, some ed. <he>עול</he>) and surrender thyself to public service in my place (v. supra).

senses.gloss: to cause to fall; to throw down.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נָפִיל</he></cite>.
B. Kam. III, 10 ה׳ את שינו struck out his tooth; Tosef. ib. IX, 23; a. fr.—Esp. to miscarry.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:1">Nidd. III, 1</cite> <he>המַפֶּלֶת וכ׳</he> if a woman loses a lump-shaped embryo; a. fr.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:9">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00728"><he>נִיפּוּל</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of נִיפּוּל) to fall apart, be spoiled.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:3">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:14">VII</cite>), 14 <he>שלא תִינָּפֵל הפת</he>, v. <cite ref="R00170"><he>צָוַוח</he></cite>.
